newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel firmer with futures, physical slow.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel firmer with futures, physical slow.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were notionally firmer with futures on Monday, but premiums were little changed in thin talk, traders said.
Barges held steady after trading on Friday at May IPE gas oil +$18 a tonne, while cargo differentials were seen under slight pressure with mounting supplies.
Traders pegged differentials at around $20 over IPE futures which closed $1.50 up on the day at $165 a tonne.
A Q3 swap traded at a $27.25 a tonne premium to prompt gas oil futures.
